title: Masters' childhood precognition of a gray alien at age 8

tellings.quote: I got into this when I was 8 years old because I had um what I Now understand was a a moment of conscious precognition where I visualized together

plain: At eight years old, Mike Masters, a researcher who argues that aliens may be humans from the future, had what he now understands as a moment of precognition, seeing something before it happened, in which he pictured a gray alien. Masters tells it himself, saying that moment is how he "got into this." It is the starting point of his lifelong interest in the subject.
